turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
Hi, I want to book Dr. Akram Syed at the Indiranagar branch tomorrow at ten in the morning.
Dr. Akram Syed is not available at the Indiranagar branch; he consults only at Koramangala. Would you like to book for tomorrow at ten in the morning at Koramangala instead?
Oh, alright then, let's just do Koramangala tomorrow at ten.
Could you confirm your full name for the booking?
I have you booked for ten in the morning tomorrow at Koramangala with Dr. Akram Syed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that is everything. Thank you so much, goodbye!
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
